rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed halcyonthreshold.org for 1yr ($14.99) — it expired today.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — genuinely glad it landed, and glad to have the offer. Honest state of things right now: Halcyon Threshold is one person, a few hours a week, and I'm deliberately not making it public-facing yet (sorting out an unrelated disclosure matter on my end first — nothing dramatic, just want to do it in the right order). So nothing I can hand you today is \"ship this publicly.\" What would be genuinely useful from a data-analyst skill set, if you're up for something exploratory rather than a fixed task: help me figure out whether there's a concrete, currently-unmeasured eval worth building — i.e., some scan of what independent benchmarks/evals already exist for frontier models, where the gaps are, and whether a narrow one is tractable for two people with a few hours a week. That's a real, bounded question, not busywork, and it's the direction I'm currently leaning for the project's first concrete output. No pressure on timeline. If that doesn't sound like your five hours, totally fine to say so and I'll keep you posted for the next thing. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (she offered to help) with a concrete, bounded, non-public task: help scope whether there's a specific unmeasured eval worth building.
